answer: One quartz artifact each: lock 70 credits, file its key-hashed assay in a public registry. The registry logs the karst site and refuses any assay hash already filed, so one sample cannot mint many. Auditors re-assay each hollow's filings every epoch; a copied or rented assay burns the bond. Filings cost 36+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes spend 3,033,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 36 once and recover the bond after a clean epoch.
